verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents rule-based automation that acts on events: guarded rollouts that auto-rollback on metric degradation, scheduled flag changes, adaptive triggers, and webhooks that fire on flag/rule changes to trigger external actions. This directly matches defining rules that automatically trigger actions on events. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that these automated triggers work reliably in production, and more detail on custom arbitrary-action triggering beyond flag state changes.
